title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #7 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah has only three verses? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Kafirun

2. What do we ask Allah for in the sixth verse of Al-Fatiha? (1 mark)
   A. To make us famous
   B. To make us win games
   C. To guide us to the straight path
   D. To give us money

3. What is a hadith? (1 mark)
   A. A Muslim festival
   B. A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   C. A type of prayer
   D. A chapter of the Qur'an

4. "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals." Who narrated this hadith according to the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Hakim
   B. Ibn Majah
   C. Muslim
   D. Abu Lahab

5. In the hadith about eating, from which part of the dish should we eat? (1 mark)
   A. The other person's side
   B. Any side we like
   C. The part directly in front of us
   D. The middle

6. Which hand should a Muslim use for eating? (1 mark)
   A. Either hand equally
   B. Left hand
   C. Right hand
   D. No hand, use a fork only

7. Which of these follows the Sunnah of eating? (1 mark)
   A. Use the left hand for pleasure
   B. Criticise the food
   C. Eat while running
   D. Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand

8. Which of these is a benefit of clean teeth? (1 mark)
   A. More cavities
   B. Toothache
   C. Fresh breath
   D. Bad breath

9. In the Prophet's teaching, before every prayer the siwak was (1 mark)
   A. Forbidden
   B. Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   C. Required only for sick people
   D. Compulsory on children only

10. Which greeting should players give at the end of a match? (1 mark)
   A. A shout
   B. An insult
   C. Silence
   D. Salaam and a handshake

11. What should a boy cover at least while playing sports? (1 mark)
   A. From the navel to the knees
   B. Only the head
   C. Nothing
   D. Only the hands

12. When the Qur'an (20:46) says Allah is with Musa and Harun "hearing and seeing", which names are shown? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   B. Ar-Rahim and As-Salam
   C. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   D. Al-Malik and As-Salam

13. Which name reminds us that Allah sees us when we are alone? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. Al-Basir
   C. As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahim

14. Which angel spoke to the Prophet in the cave of Hira? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Atid
   C. Israfil
   D. Jibril

15. Which duty belongs to Jibril? (1 mark)
   A. Taking souls
   B. Bringing revelation
   C. Recording deeds
   D. Blowing the Trumpet

16. Which angel is in charge of rain and provision? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Raqib
   C. Israfil
   D. Mikail

17. Which angel takes the souls at death? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Raqib
   C. Malakul Maut
   D. Mikail

18. What is the correct way to mention an angel's name? (1 mark)
   A. Insult
   B. Say "alayhis-salam"
   C. Say nothing
   D. Say "S.A.W."

19. Who was Yusuf's father? (1 mark)
   A. Ismail
   B. Ishaq
   C. Ibrahim
   D. Yaqub

20. How many prophets are named in the Qur'an, as taught at Grade 4? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Ninety-nine
   C. Forty
   D. Twenty-five

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

22. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

23. State three values learned from participating in sports. (3 marks)

24. Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family? (3 marks)

25. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)

26. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

27. Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them. (5 marks)

28. How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

2. C — To guide us to the straight path
   The verse is "Guide us to the straight path".

3. B — A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Hadith records what the Prophet said, did or approved.

4. A — Al-Hakim
   The syllabus gives Al-Hakim as the narrator.

5. C — The part directly in front of us
   The hadith says "eat what is directly in front of you".

6. C — Right hand
   The Prophet taught eating with the right.

7. D — Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   These are Sunnah manners.

8. C — Fresh breath
   Clean teeth give fresh breath.

9. B — Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   He said he would have ordered it if not hard.

10. D — Salaam and a handshake
   Respect and greetings are Islamic manners.

11. A — From the navel to the knees
   This is the minimum covering.

12. C — As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   Allah hears and sees.

13. B — Al-Basir
   Al-Basir sees everything.

14. D — Jibril
   Jibril came with the first revelation.

15. B — Bringing revelation
   He delivered the Qur'an.

16. D — Mikail
   Scholars explain this duty of Mikail.

17. C — Malakul Maut
   Malakul Maut is the Angel of Death, also called Izrail.

18. B — Say "alayhis-salam"
   We say peace be upon him.

19. D — Yaqub
   Yusuf was the son of Yaqub.

20. D — Twenty-five
   Muslims learn twenty-five names.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each value.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.
